query: What is the refund policy for annual subscriptions?

history.compressed_text: I recently upgraded to an annual plan last month and I am not entirely sure it was the right decision for me. I was wondering if there is any way to get a refund or switch back to monthly billing.

docs.compressed_text: Annual Subscriptions: Customers who purchase annual subscription plans are eligible for a full refund if the refund request is submitted within 30 days of the initial purchase date. After the 30-day window, refunds are calculated on a prorated basis: the refund amount equals the unused portion of the subscription, minus a 10% administrative fee. To request a refund, customers must contact our support team at support@example.com or through the in-app Help Centre.
